name: api
description: API da Doce Encanto Confeitaria: catálogo, pedidos e painel administrativo

scripts.start:prod: node scripts/prisma.mjs generate && node scripts/prisma.mjs migrate deploy && node dist/server.js
scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('Criado api/.env a partir do .env.example')}" && node scripts/prisma.mjs generate && node scripts/prisma.mjs migrate deploy && node scripts/prisma.mjs db seed
scripts.test:postgres: DB_PROVIDER=postgresql node scripts/prisma.mjs generate && vitest run; status=$?; node scripts/prisma.mjs generate; exit $status
